stories.headline: Pemex safety risks increase 117% with aging infrastructure posing growing threats
stories.summary: A Proceso investigation revealed that safety risks at Pemex facilities have increased 117% from the Peña Nieto to Sheinbaum administrations, with 78% of risky conditions exceeding committed repair timelines. The report highlights aging installations, pipeline corrosion, and equipment failures as major concerns.

stories.summary: The Defense Ministry deployed 1,170 troops to Tijuana, Ciudad Juárez, and León to combat organized crime, while conducting security exercises for the 2026 World Cup. Operations include aerial transport capabilities and scenario-based training for major event security.

stories.summary: Navy forces carried out operations in Sinaloa targeting organized crime groups, briefly detaining a daughter of cartel leader 'Mayo' Zambada before releasing her. Operations also seized weapons and tactical equipment from locations used by criminal cells.

stories.headline: Sheinbaum announces universal health credentialing system starting in April
stories.summary: President Sheinbaum confirmed that a universal health credentialing process will begin in April, allowing people to receive medical care at any public hospital regardless of their insurance affiliation. The initiative aims to create a unified healthcare access system.

articles.title: Confirma Sheinbaum credencialización universal de salud

stories.headline: Sheinbaum commemorates Benito Juárez anniversary with 4T continuity message
stories.summary: President Sheinbaum led the 220th anniversary commemoration of Benito Juárez's birth in Guelatao, Oaxaca, linking the historical figure's legacy to the Fourth Transformation project. She inaugurated a statue and signed a decree recognizing Margarita Maza's diplomatic contributions.

articles.title: Juárez vive en la 4T, asegura Sheinbaum; encabeza homenaje en Oaxaca

stories.headline: Political tensions rise as electoral reform faces resistance from allies
stories.summary: President Sheinbaum encountered legislative pushback on her electoral reform proposals, including resistance from coalition partners PVEM and PT. The tensions extend to other areas including responses to teachers' strikes and internal Morena divisions over candidate selections.
